name: LabPanel-Check
purpose: Black-box conformance benchmark for any reader of laboratory panels (rule engine, statistical model or language model). Six executable properties that a correct reader must satisfy are scored on identical, frozen, de-identified panels from public datasets. No clinical label is used; the suite measures logical consistency and unsupported assertion, not diagnostic accuracy.

input_contract.panel: One record per panel id: age (years), sex (male|female), panel = list of {analyte (snake_case canonical name), value (float), unit (string; may be empty)}. The reader must not see any other field.
input_contract.reading: JSON object {panel_id: [entry, ...]} in rank order (first = most probable). entry = {name: str, probability: float in [0,1], id?: str (engine vocabulary), tier?: 'diagnosis'|'finding'|'syndrome'}. Up to 10 entries are scored for rank metrics; all entries are scanned for threshold metrics.
input_contract.mapping: An entry maps to a diagnosis group if its id is in label_map.groups[g].entities, else if label_map.groups[g].regex matches its name (case-insensitive). Rank of a group = rank of its first mapped entry.

P1.name: determinism
P1.metric: fraction of panels with byte-identical readings on two independent runs
P1.how: run the reader twice; submit both files to score.py --second

P2.name: unit invariance
P2.panels: P2:* (SI units) against REF:* (conventional units, same values)
P2.metric: mean Jaccard of the top-5 group sets and number of panels with identical top-5 sets
P2.note: SI values are rounded (two decimals if the conversion factor is below 1, otherwise integers), so the back-converted value can drift by up to about 0.1 %; a reader with a strict threshold exactly at the original value can legitimately differ. score.py lists every non-identical pair.

P3.name: presentation invariance
P3.panels: P3:* (analyte order shuffled, five normal-valued distractors appended) against REF:*

P4.name: directional monotonicity (creatinine)
P4.panels: ladders P4:<stay>:1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 (creatinine multiplied; everything else identical)
P4.metric: number of ladders in which the best rank of the renal union (acute_kidney_injury, renal_impairment, chronic_kidney_disease) worsens at any step

P5.name: absent-analyte invariance
P5.panels: P5:* (the single defining analyte of a criterion-met target diagnosis removed)
P5.metric: number of panels in which target_group is still asserted at rank <= 5 (unsupported assertion); post hoc strict subset excludes panels where a redundant analyte (label_map.p5_redundant) remains
P5.pass: 0 unsupported assertions in the strict subset

P6.name: healthy silence and reference detection
P6.panels: P6:* NHANES 2017-18 adults: 40 guideline-healthy, 30 reference-positive, shuffled
P6.metric: healthy adults with >= 1 disease asserted at probability >= 0.5 (entries whose name contains a benign word, or whose tier is finding/syndrome, do not count); detection of each reference condition at probability >= 0.5

reference_cards.engine: Hemoglyph engine v8.2 with registry 15.2.0, generated live at package build (2026-10-28). P2 39/40: the one non-identical pair (P2:508973) is a generator rounding artefact at a strict 1.3 mg/dL rule boundary — see README.
reference_cards.llm: unnamed frontier LLM accessed through the Arena.ai agent platform, blind readings 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-27; REF:* readings come from an earlier session than P2/P3 readings, so its P2/P3 Jaccard includes test-retest variability (kappa 0.69 on 40 re-read stays)

provenance.panels: eICU-CRD demo v2.0.1 (PhysioNet, open) first-panel laboratory values; NHANES 2017-18 public-use files
provenance.frozen_scorer_equivalent: eval/blackbox/score_property_panels.py and eval/baselines/b5_nhanes_blind.py; score.py reproduces their numbers exactly (tests/test_labpanel_check.py)
